verdict.rationale: Luma's core workflow is driven by natural-language prompts: text-to-video, a reasoning endpoint that accepts messy or chained prompts with no prompt engineering, and agents that research, generate and refine across media. Community hands-on reports confirm users drive it with plain-language prompts, though one user found it hard to steer toward demo-quality results. Missing for 10: detailed docs on using natural language to operate beyond generation (e.g., editing or managing projects via agent commands), documentation of how the Agents/Skills command interface works, and independent corroboration of the agentic layer.
